mapper.insert: INSERT INTO draft_lifecycle_event (draft_id, event_type, actor_user_id, source_type, status_before, status_after, summary, created_at) VALUES (#{draftId}, #{eventType}, #{actorUserId}, #{sourceType}, #{statusBefore}, #{statusAfter}, #{summary}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, draft_id AS draftId, event_type AS eventType, actor_user_id AS actorUserId, source_type AS sourceType, status_before AS statusBefore, status_after AS statusAfter, summary, created_at AS createdAt FROM draft_lifecycle_event WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY id ASC
